items:

 earth of substation.

Connect the HV leads (H): connecting red 
 clamp to HV bushing ( R ) and black one to HV bushing (S)

Connect the LV leads (X): connecting red 
 clamp to LV bushing (r) and black one LV bushing (n).

Turn on the test unit power supply then the

 Hence the test unit is ready for measurement process.

With the previous connections , and your OLTC

 until the reading in the LCD become fixed.

Record your obtained result in a table as 
 shown below, then press the RESET button to reset for the following test.

Move the OLTC to point 2 and rerun the test 
 , then record the obtained result, then RESET

Repeat the previous steps with OLTC in all 
 positions and record your obtained results
Change the test leads H between HV bushings (S) and (T), whereas the leads x between LV bushings (S) and (n)

Repeat measuring the turns ratio for all 
 positions of OLTC and record the obtained results

Repeat step 9 between HV bushings (T)&(R) and 
 LV bushings (t) & (n), then repeat step 10.

Compare the obtained results with calculated 
 values

Introduction
This document outlines the testing procedure P1, 
which performed every year as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.
Note: This step by step instructions are for 
testing the turns ratio for the power transformers,
using test set DTR Model 8500 (AEMC INSTRUMENTS 
).
The first draft initiated & tested at 
Elaasher 3 substation by eng. Ebraheem Hasan from Elaasher protection management, reviewed by protection manager 
eng. Fawzy Barakat, accepted by general 
manager eng. Elsaaied Nagy, revised by quality control manager eng. Mohamed 
Emran, and approved by eng. Wageeh Mansy Head Sector of Protection, 
Measurements & Testes Canal Zone, and accepted by eng. Aly Attiah el Deib 
EETC Canal Zone MPIS Coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the 
 qualified testing staff should carry the suitable safety categories.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.
Wear 
 safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, 
 safety shoes ... etc.
The earthing connection must be the first made 
 and the last removed.
Tools and Equipment
Test equipment type DTR 
 Model 8500 AEMC INSTRUMENTS

Preparations
Take the transformer out of service.
Discharge the transformer windings static 
 charge.
Disassembly all clamps from bushings (High 
 Voltage side, Low Voltage side & tertiary if exists).
Don't misapply the High leads and Low leads of 
 the test equipment to the transformer bushings.
 (Misapply will cause damage to the test equipment)
Keep test leads apart from the bushings.

Connect the HV leads (H): connecting red

Connect the LV leads (X): connecting red 
 clamp to LV bushing (r) and black one LV bushing (n).
Turn on the test unit power supply then the 
 following messages will appear:-
 AEMC INSTRUMENTS 
 DTR MODLE 8500
 VT/PT Test Mode

 Please Wait

 Hence the test unit is ready for measurement process.
With the previous connections , and your OLTC 
 is in position no. 1 press the red test switch to check continuity and stay 
 until the reading in the LCD become fixed.
Record your obtained result in a table as 
 shown below, then press the RESET button to reset for the following test.
Move the OLTC to point 2 and rerun the test 
 , then record the obtained result, then RESET
Repeat the previous steps with OLTC in all 
 positions and record your obtained results
Change the test leads H between HV bushings (S) and (T), whereas the leads x between LV bushings (S) and (n)
Repeat measuring the turns ratio for all 
 positions of OLTC and record the obtained results
Repeat step 9 between HV bushings (T)&(R) and 
 LV bushings (t) & (n), then repeat step 10.
